title: Lead Network Engineer
description:
Join Amazon as a Lead Network Engineer and be part of our mission to transform the industry. We're a team of driven professionals who love what we do and are committed to excellence.

**The Opportunity:**
We're expanding our team and looking for a skilled Lead Network Engineer with strong expertise in tech. This role offers tremendous growth potential and the chance to work on challenging, meaningful projects.

**Day-to-Day Responsibilities:**
- Plan, prioritize, and execute tech projects to meet deadlines
- Collaborate with team members across departments
- Create detailed documentation and reports
- Conduct research and analysis to support decision-making
- Present findings and recommendations to leadership
- Continuously improve processes and workflows

**Must-Have Qualifications:**
- Minimum 10 years of experience as a Lead Network Engineer or similar
- In-depth knowledge of JavaScript, React, Communication, Microservices
- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
- Team player with a proactive mindset

**Perks & Benefits:**
- Salary range: IRR 22,000,000,000 – IRR 38,000,000,000
- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Health and wellness allowance
- Professional development opportunities
- Team offsites and company events
- Modern office with great amenities

Join polaris as a Junior Pharmacist and be part of our mission to transform the industry. We're a team of driven professionals who love what we do and are committed to excellence.

**The Opportunity:**
We're expanding our team and looking for a skilled Junior Pharmacist with strong expertise in general. This role offers tremendous growth potential and the chance to work on challenging, meaningful projects.

**Day-to-Day Responsibilities:**
- Plan, prioritize, and execute general projects to meet deadlines
- Collaborate with team members across departments
- Create detailed documentation and reports
- Conduct research and analysis to support decision-making
- Present findings and recommendations to leadership
- Continuously improve processes and workflows

**Must-Have Qualifications:**
- Minimum 6 years of experience as a Junior Pharmacist or similar
- In-depth knowledge of Project Management, Communication, Team Management, Analytical Thinking
- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
- Team player with a proactive mindset

**Perks & Benefits:**
- Salary range: IRR 38,000,000,000 – IRR 65,000,000,000

- Health and wellness allowance
- Professional development opportunities
- Team offsites and company events
- Modern office with great amenities

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for a talented Principal Software Engineer to join our dynamic team at NDT. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining tech solutions that drive business growth and innovation.

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement new features
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code/work
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices
- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and bugs
- Mentor junior team members and share knowledge across the organization
- Communicate effectively with stakeholders to understand business requirements

**Requirements:**
- 2 years of experience in a similar role
- Strong proficiency in AWS, Stakeholder Management, Problem Solving, Agile
- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience
- Strong communication and collaboration skills

**What We Offer:**
- Competitive salary of IRR 38,000,000,000 – IRR 65,000,000,000 per year
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Learning and development budget
- Collaborative and inclusive work environment
